name: 等待事件诊断方法论
description: Oracle 等待事件分为 12 个类别：User I/O、System I/O、Concurrency、Application、Configuration、Administrative、Network、Commit、Idle、Scheduler、Cluster、Other。性能诊断的核心方法：DB Time = CPU Time + Non-Idle Wait Time。从 AWR/ASH Top 等待事件入手，定位具体瓶颈。

signals.desc: 需要系统性地诊断性能问题

root_causes.name: IO 类等待（User I/O）
root_causes.desc: db file sequential read（索引单块读）、db file scattered read（全表多块读）。通常意味着 SQL 效率低或 buffer cache 不足。

root_causes.name: 并发类等待（Concurrency）
root_causes.desc: cursor: pin S/wait on X、library cache lock/pin、buffer busy waits。通常意味着硬解析过多或热点块争用。

root_causes.name: 配置类等待（Configuration）
root_causes.desc: log file sync、log file switch。通常意味着 Redo 配置不当或存储 IO 问题。

root_causes.name: 集群类等待（Cluster）
root_causes.desc: gc cr/current request。RAC 特有，跨实例块传输。

root_causes.name: CPU 瓶颈
root_causes.desc: DB Time 中 CPU 时间占比高，等待少。通常是 SQL 效率低（逻辑读过高）或系统负载高。

step1_db_time_breakdown.sql: SELECT stat_name, ROUND(value/1e6, 1) seconds FROM v$sys_time_model WHERE stat_name IN ('DB time', 'DB CPU', 'sql execute elapsed time', 'parse time elapsed', 'hard parse elapsed time') ORDER BY value DESC

step2_top_wait_events.sql: SELECT event, wait_class, total_waits, ROUND(time_waited_micro/GREATEST(total_waits,1)/1000, 2) avg_ms, ROUND(time_waited_micro/1e6) total_sec FROM v$system_event WHERE wait_class != 'Idle' ORDER BY time_waited_micro DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

step3_wait_class_summary.sql: SELECT wait_class, SUM(total_waits) total_waits, ROUND(SUM(time_waited_micro)/1e6) total_sec FROM v$system_event WHERE wait_class != 'Idle' GROUP BY wait_class ORDER BY SUM(time_waited_micro) DESC

step4_ash_recent_waits.desc: 最近 30 分钟的 ASH Top 等待
step4_ash_recent_waits.sql: SELECT event, sql_id, COUNT(*) samples, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) sessions FROM v$active_session_history WHERE sample_time > SYSDATE - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE AND event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY event, sql_id ORDER BY samples DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

step5_wait_event_guide.sql: SELECT 'db file sequential read' event, 'User I/O' class, '索引单块读，检查SQL效率和buffer cache' action FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'db file scattered read', 'User I/O', '全表多块读，检查是否缺少索引或分区裁剪失败' FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'log file sync', 'Commit', '日志写入等待，检查存储IO和commit频率' FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'cursor: pin S wait on X', 'Concurrency', '硬解析争用，检查绑定变量使用' FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'buffer busy waits', 'Concurrency', '缓冲区争用，检查热点块' FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'gc cr request', 'Cluster', 'RAC跨实例块传输，检查实例亲和性' FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'enq: TX - row lock contention', 'Application', '行锁争用，检查应用逻辑' FROM dual

branches.label: 有 DB Time 数据 — 分析等待类别
有等待事件 — 按类别归因
RC1: IO 类等待占主导
branches.confidence: 置信度 85%: User I/O 等待时间长
findings: IO 类等待（db file sequential/scattered read）占 DB Time 主要部分

actions.desc: 优化 SQL 减少 IO 或增大 Buffer Cache

branches.label: RC2: 并发类等待占主导
branches.confidence: 置信度 80%: Concurrency 等待显著
findings: 并发类等待（buffer busy waits、latch、cursor pin 等）显著

actions.desc: 分析具体并发等待事件

branches.label: RC4: 集群类等待
branches.confidence: 置信度 75%: Cluster 等待存在
findings: RAC 集群等待（gc 相关），需检查实例亲和性

actions.desc: 参考 ORA_184 gc 等待诊断

branches.label: RC5: CPU 瓶颈或其他
branches.confidence: 置信度 70%: 排除等待后归因
findings: DB CPU 占比高或配置类等待

actions.desc: 检查 DB CPU 在 DB Time 中的占比

branches.label: 无等待事件 — CPU bound
branches.confidence: 置信度 80%: 无等待事件说明 CPU 消耗为主
findings: 无显著等待事件，系统可能是 CPU bound

actions.desc: 优化 SQL 减少 CPU 消耗

branches.label: 无 DB Time 数据
findings: 未获取到 DB Time 分解数据
